# Dev Riasat — Muhammad Riasat Ali

> Muhammad Riasat Ali ("Dev Riasat") is a government-certified full-stack web developer based in Islamabad, Pakistan, with 5+ years of experience and 100+ delivered projects. He builds WordPress, WooCommerce, React, Next.js and Node.js websites for clients in Pakistan, the UK, Canada (especially Montreal & Quebec), Australia and Europe.

## Services
- WordPress & WooCommerce websites and stores
- React / Next.js web apps and SaaS dashboards
- White-label development for Pakistani marketing & SEO agencies
- Bilingual (FR/EN) websites for Quebec cafés, jewellery shops and boutiques
- Speed, SEO and Core Web Vitals optimization

## Credentials
- Soft Skills Training certificate — Overseas Employment Corporation (OEC) & ICMPD
